boundaries: All tests stay in memory. Reuse accepted validators/planners and existing controlled fixtures; inject only external/provider/assessment seams for explicit error contracts. Assert typed refusal, original findings, exact retained bytes and absence/presence of real planned effects instead of asserting implementation traversal. No subprocess/filesystem/native calls.
critical_module_branches: Control map includes successful snapshot import, canonical inventory write, blocked/clean extension import, explicit approval and acceptance source/view publication, as well as refusal branches. It does not select superficial lines solely to cross floors.

Other failed bodies have no same-source focused proof in the released candidate; earlier incomplete/no-coverage passes cannot fill their missing coordinates. All existing zero-loss comparisons pass.

Use exact final current coverage plus additive proof only for diagnosis; final acceptance still requires the coordinator-released clean ordered single-process reversed complete population with unchanged BODY/no-loss reader and four contracts. No behavioral execution is released by this proposal.

controls.observable_assertion: Configured uncaptured input is refused before any physical read, write or result artifact.
An injected required-read adapter contract violation returning None is refused without fabricated bytes or effects; the real missing-file OSError control remains unchanged.
Naive trusted clock is rejected with SERVICE_CLOCK before capture/publication.
An activation result without a selected profile is rejected with SERVICE_PROFILE; no graph or write authority is fabricated.
Profile bytes changing between trusted selection and capture cause SERVICE_CAPTURE with no writer call.
Reauthorization changing authenticated actor causes SERVICE_AUTHORITY before dispatch or write.
A valid request from another operation family is refused by bootstrap without initialization effects.
Omitted profile path uses actual trusted activation selection and returns its exact captured bytes without writes.
Unsupported profile version returns a typed refusal, never a successful profile artifact.
Malformed v2 profile retains original ProfileError findings and blocking result, with no activation or writer call.
ProfileError at analyzer selection retains its original typed findings instead of becoming a selector error or proceeding to analysis/publication.
Inventory write composes the real canonical planner with exact grants and selected analyzer IDs; injected preview output cannot become publication authority.
Changed physical source bytes after capture are refused; no stale source row or writer call is returned.
Captured source exceeding the requested reader bound is refused before publication or source-row retention.
An invalid direct source request is classified SERVICE_SOURCE without reading or writing its requested data.
A valid request from another family is refused without graph assessment or write effects.
Missing capture cannot produce an authored proposal view or grant publication authority.
Explicit replacement identity differing from captured document is refused without a plan or write.
A decision that is not actually approved cannot be upgraded by the approve request; captured payload remains unchanged.
Approval-owner mismatch is refused without replacing the captured decision.
Approval-evidence mismatch is refused without inventing evidence or replacing the decision.
Matching explicit approval preserves exact payload, identity, owner, evidence and expected digest in the bounded replacement proposal.
A non-bootstrap mutation without capture fails before planning or writes.
Transport without capture fails without export/import effects.
Unknown export identity fails exact selection without emitting a transport or writing files.
Ambiguous export identity fails exact selection without choosing an arbitrary authored record.
A valid captured snapshot import composes the accepted planner, exact manifest/source identity and guarded publication as one bounded operation.
Valid extension inventory preview preserves source identity and proposed exact bytes without invoking a writer.
Blocking extension diagnostics remain blocking in preview, with no successful/publication claim or writer call.
Valid extension inventory write uses its exact normalized document in one prospective plan and existing guarded writer.
A valid request from another family is refused without a mutation plan or write.
Malformed findings container is rejected rather than interpreted as an empty successful assessment.
Malformed findings entry is rejected without suppressing a potentially blocking diagnostic.
Report resource failure propagates before serialization, fallback assessment or publication.
A non-validation projection error propagates without a replacement success envelope or write.
Malformed validate-all core retains actual public-validator failure findings and exit1, with no report plan or writer call.
A trusted projection with an invalid validation result is rejected before artifacts or publication.
Markdown preview retains all real ready/pending structured specifications and selected Markdown views while excluding Gherkin; no writer call or invented readiness.
Gherkin preview retains all ready/pending structured specifications and only eligible Gherkin views; pending criteria remain non-executable and no writer is called.
Acceptance write composes complete structured sources and selected views in one actual prospective plan, retaining findings and exact identity/digests without inventing execution proof.
A valid request from another operation family is refused without projection or publication.
